overall_goal: Clean up the workspace by discarding rubbish, recycling packaging, and loading the dishwasher

goals.description: Remove debris from the pan and spatula and discard it in the bin
goals.rationale: The person puts down the spatula to pick out onion skin and debris from the pan, throws it in the bin, and then taps the spatula to clean it.

goals.description: Dispose of cardboard trays in the recycling bin
goals.rationale: The person stacks empty cardboard trays, carries them over, and places them into the recycling bin.

goals.description: Clear the countertop and load the glass jug into the dishwasher
goals.rationale: The person moves utensils and a bowl out of the way to pick up a glass jug, then opens the dishwasher and places the jug inside.
